description:
A set of keys was found in the lobby with a tag showing only the last 4 digits of a phone number: '9876'. 

Your task is to:
1. Open the 'Found_Keys_Info.txt' file on the desktop to see the details.
2. Open Jolly Lobby Track and search the visitor database to identify the owner of the keys using the partial phone number.
3. Create a file at '/home/ga/Documents/key_owner.txt' containing the owner's Full Name.
4. Update the visitor's record in Lobby Track by adding the exact text 'Lost keys returned to owner' to the Notes/Comments field.
5. Save the record.
